step_by_step_reasoning:
1) No knowledge-base functions apply to this task, so none were considered.
2) The Manage Products grid currently shows "No records found." Filters may be active; reset filters by clicking the cell "Reset Filter Search" -> "Reset Filter" to clear criteria.
3) Click the same cell's "Search" button to refresh the listing.
4) Attempt to locate the product by finding a row whose accessible name contains "Minerva LumaTech V-Tee" and clicking the link within that row. Fall back to a page-level link if necessary. If the product cannot be found, raise an exception.
5) Once on the product edit page, open the Custom Options tab by trying tab, link, and button roles in order.
6) Add a new option by clicking likely "Add New Option" buttons (with several common variations) or an "Add" button fallback.
7) Fill the new option title as "Size" by selecting the last reachable Title textbox, and set the option Type combobox to "Drop-down" (prefer the last combobox named Type).
8) Add a value for the drop-down by attempting to fill the most-recent or last textbox with "XXXL".
9) Save the product as the final action. If the primary Save button fails, try "Save and Continue Edit", then any Save-like button via regex.

I used scoped get_by_role calls where possible (for the Reset Filter/Search cell and row-scoped product link) to avoid ambiguity in the admin UI. Small sleeps and wait_for_load_state calls are included to allow the Magento admin JS to render dynamic sections. The function raises clear exceptions when critical steps (finding the product, opening Custom Options) cannot be completed so that failures are visible to the caller.
